# Shiraz Abubakar

> Full Stack Developer and Agentic AI Engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan, building production web apps and multi-agent AI systems.

Shiraz builds for two audiences: recruiters/clients evaluating his engineering work, and 
developers interested in agentic AI system design (multi-agent pipelines, MCP servers, 
LLM-powered automation). He is Lead Developer at Ziybex, a web/marketing agency, and writes 
about practical AI engineering patterns on his blog.

## Projects

- [Ustaad.ai](https://ustad-ai-service-373424250185.us-central1.run.app/): Multi-agent AI tutoring platform for Pakistani students in Hinglish, Silver Tier winner at Google AI Seekho 2026
- [Personal AI Employee](https://github.com/shirazkk/Personal-AI-Employee): Local-first AI assistant using Claude Code CLI, Obsidian, and Gmail polling for autonomous task handling
- [AI Lead Generator](https://github.com/shirazkk/ai-lead-generator): End-to-end system that finds businesses with weak online presence, scores opportunity, and sends personalized outreach
- [Jarvis Guardian AI](https://github.com/shirazkk/Jarvis-Guardian-AI): Face and voice recognition security agent for Windows with WhatsApp alerting
- [Ziybex](https://ziybex.com): Creative marketing and web agency platform Shiraz leads engineering for
